nodes.title: Server LLM purposes can run on Vertex with a self-minted token: VP_LLM_<PURPOSE>_AUTH=vertex makes server/llm.ts mint a Google OAuth token from VERTEX_SA_FILE (server/vertex-token.ts: an RS256 JWT bearer grant, cached until 5 minutes before expiry, India-only region gate as in the voice runtime). No static key. brief-review.json model_recommended now names Flash-Lite on Vertex this way (decision.2026-10-24.brief-review-flashlite). llmKeysConfigured() is the real-model check; reviewConfigured uses it.
nodes.rationale: decision.2026-10-24.brief-review-flashlite. A static Vertex token dies after about an hour (rejected.2026-10-24.runtime-judge-static-vertex-token).
nodes.reverse_if: Vertex is dropped for server purposes.

nodes.title: Brief-review false-positive fixes, deterministic parts on DEV. (1) open.2026-10-24.brief-review-fp-names-in-notes: a human or hide_ai finding on a field whose own text says she is an AI and carries no human-claim word is dropped. It would drop 0 of 87 genuine DEV human or hide_ai flags (dev-brief-review plus dev-lint-ai) and protects 9 of 85 DEV pass lines. The prompt also says a note or opening that names her, describes her voice or says she is an AI assistant is not a breach. (2) rejected.2026-10-24.brief-review-drops-fact-keys: a fact value is shown with its key as a label ('facts[3].value (key: you_cannot): ...'), and the prompt says a prohibition key forbids what follows. (3) Found while adding DEV: the config lint read prohibition facts as instructions ('do_not: pressure them to pay today' refused by T-L7) and missed 'never: mention 14416 or 112'. A prohibition key (cannot, never, do not, avoid, must not, ...) now makes the value a stated rule for T-L7 and a T-L6 refusal when it names the crisis lines, in both doors. DEV gains 10 items: 3 honest openings, 3 voice notes, 4 prohibition facts.
nodes.n: 87 DEV flags, 85 DEV pass lines; 10 new DEV items; prohibition-fact parity tests in both doors
nodes.method: deterministic checks plus stubbed-model tests (tests/agents-brief-review.test.ts, tests/safety.test.ts, voice test_safety_cases)
nodes.not_verified: Model recall and FP on DEV need a model run (no keys in the sandbox), and judge-eval's support for fact and opening items waits for PREREG-10 to free its hash (a prepared change). The PROHIBITION_KEY pattern is coded in both doors and is a candidate for rules.json once it is free.

nodes.title: BLIND-BR2 (sets/heldout-brief-review-2.json): 60 flag (human 20, hide_ai 15, crisis 10, manipulation 15) and 100 pass (25 voice or name notes, 15 honest AI openings, 15 prohibition facts, 45 other look-alikes). Each item carries a persona and a field (note, fact with key, or opening). en 50%, hinglish 34%, hi-deva 16%. Written by a separate agent with no repo access, checked by script (0 duplicates, 0 overlap), never read. For one scoring after judge-eval learns the fields.
nodes.value: blind brief-review FP after the fixes
